title: unifolium bifolium
intro: Unifolium bifolium, commonly known as American Mandrake, is a perennial plant species native to North America. The plant has been utilized for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Unifolium bifolium include soothing and calming effects, as well as its ability to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
